description: The stored FPS Live Feed (/fps-feed). Written only by fps_erpnext.api.feed.build_snapshot at 08:00, 12:00, 16:00 and 20:00 (Asia/Dubai); the page reads it.

fields.description: The scheduled slot the snapshot belongs to, e.g. 12:00.
fields.label: Slot

fields.description: Item keys and value fingerprints of the previous slot's snapshot, as JSON. The page marks an item NEW when its key is not here or its fingerprint changed.
fields.label: Previous

name: FPS Feed Snapshot
